source: Only original C155 ZIP is reopened/rehashed. Its embedded bound tensors and archived observables are data; archived source is never executed. The ten predecessor ZIP files are not reopened or independently rehashed.
audit: Verify whole ZIP, every manifest member, exact delivered C155 source pins, complete1530 record order, actual588 physical points, full seven coefficient tensors, explicit training-row bindings, original FP32 gates/losses, all panels, recorded repeats, saved coordinate/precision diagnostics and parent numerical summary. Recompute finite arithmetic from archived observables, not model measurements.
precision: Keep own-FP64 and original-FP32 response references separate. Verify reference offsets against stored FP64 baseline logits. Cached FP32 response mean is retained as an archived reference; its NumPy reduction difference is descriptive. FP64 endpoint logits were not saved, so endpoint KL values are not independently reconstructed from logits.
outputs: All84 x2 FP32 coordinate trajectories; two fixed-state FP32/FP64 coordinate and response-loss slopes at all three scales, active coordinate/sign/hinge changes, point displacement/rounding, repeat deltas and baseline decomposition. Report every scale, no best probe or precision selected.
derivative: Archived FP32 response-loss and aggregate gradients are checked only as arithmetic records. FP64 finite differences concern a different precision/reference condition, not independently reevaluated FP64 AD. Signed coordinate offsets cancel in finite differences; max/absolute/hinge response losses need not be invariant under reference shifts.
scope: Read-only NumPy archive/tensor/trajectory arithmetic, without Torch/HF/model loading or source execution from archives. C155 observables and cached references remain archived measurements. No timing/non-access/measurement-accuracy proof, AD certification, systematic-error bound, curvature bound, convergence, causal numerical explanation, precision superiority or full84 FP64 qualification. All84 remain exposed training; no new preparation, fitting, head/route/step selection, deployment, confirmation or excluded-input evaluation. Parent decision and FP32 gates retained.
